### 📄 `dev/resolve-agent/skills/resolve-drive-pr/review_cycle.py` (L101-L102)

ℹ️ Shown here because this finding is low severity.

`gh_json` returns `None` on empty stdout, but this immediately calls `pull.get("state")` / `pull["head"]["sha"]`. A `None` response raises `AttributeError`, which is not in `main`'s caught-exception list, so instead of the clean fail-closed "Review cycle not complete" message the script dies with an unhandled traceback. Validate the response shape before use.

<details><summary>💡 Suggested Change</summary>

**Before:**
```
    pull = request(["api", f"repos/{repository}/pulls/{number}"])
    if pull.get("state") != "open" or pull.get("draft"):
```

**After:**
```
    pull = request(["api", f"repos/{repository}/pulls/{number}"])
    if not isinstance(pull, dict):
        raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected response for pull {number}")
    if pull.get("state") != "open" or pull.get("draft"):
```

</details>

![maintainability · low](https://img.shields.io/badge/maintainability-low-green)
### 📄 `dev/resolve-agent/skills/resolve-drive-pr/review_cycle.py` (L277-L286)

ℹ️ Shown here because this finding is low severity.

Catching `KeyError` and `TypeError` here converts genuine programming bugs (unexpected API response shapes, dict-access typos) into a terse "Review cycle not complete: 'sha'" with no traceback, hurting diagnosability. It still fails closed, so this is non-blocking, but consider narrowing the list to the expected failures (GitHubError, RuntimeError, OSError, ValueError, TimeoutExpired) and/or printing the exception type or traceback to stderr for debugging.
